tutorial.name: Create a Holoscan Module
tutorial.description: End-to-end walkthrough for scaffolding, building, testing, packaging, and publishing a new Holoscan Module. Covers external (standalone) modules built, tested, packaged, and published from their own repositories.

changelog.0.2.0: Update the standalone Module workflow for the Holoscan SDK 5.0 C++ API and Debian packaging
